item.chainsawman.pochita.tooltip.0: A chainsaw in your hands. Set him down on the ground.
message.chainsawman.merged: Pochita is your heart now. Pull the cord [%s] to become Chainsaw Man, and again to turn back.
message.chainsawman.downed: Down. A friend can pull your cord (crouch by you, hold use) and you come back as Chainsaw Man. Up by yourself in %s:%s
subtitles.chainsawman.form.slash_air: Saw blade whips through the air
subtitles.chainsawman.beam.burst: Beam bursts up out of the ground
chainsawman.beam.keys: Walk on his legs   [%6$s] Dive and swim   [%1$s] Bite   [Hold %1$s] Saw   [%2$s] Charge   [%3$s] Leap   [%5$s] Throw you   [%4$s] Get off
chainsawman.beam.no_room: There is no room for Beam here
merge.chainsawman.line1: Pochita... Did you take my body, like I said?
merge.chainsawman.line2: I always loved hearing you talk about your dreams, Denji.
merge.chainsawman.line3: Here's the deal. I'll give you my heart...
merge.chainsawman.line4: And in exchange, I want you to show me your dream.
commands.chainsaw.eternity: The Eternity Devil's hotel stands in front of you. It wakes at night.
commands.chainsaw.owner: Pochita is %s's: only they can feed him and merge with him.
commands.chainsaw.owner.none: Pochita is nobody's: anyone can feed him and merge with him.
commands.chainsaw.mobs: A row of mobs in front of you, standing still.
commands.chainsaw.pochita: A wild Pochita, fainted in a log beside you.
commands.chainsaw.reset: Pochita's heart taken back, out of the form, full of blood.
commands.chainsaw.scene: Test ground ready. Try it in order:
commands.chainsaw.scene.1: 1. Pochita is fainted in the log to your right: hold use on him till he's yours.
commands.chainsaw.scene.2: 2. Die with him near (/damage @s 100): the merge. When it says, press [%1$s].
commands.chainsaw.scene.3: 3. On the mobs in front: click to slash, hold to grind (it cuts through walls too), right-click to lunge, [%2$s] the chain, [%3$s] Beam, [V] kick. Kills cut them in two.
commands.chainsaw.scene.4: 4. Press [%1$s] again to turn back, and again to change.
commands.chainsaw.scene.5: 5. /chainsaw down, then /chainsaw up: your limbs come off, and you get up.
commands.chainsaw.scene.6: 6. /chainsawhead boxes or /chainsawhead mesh: the two heads to choose between.
commands.chainsaw.scene.7: Also: chain a mob and jump into water to drag it under. /chainsaw mobs (more mobs), heart (skip the merge), reset (see it again), blood, pochita.
commands.chainsawhead.boxes: The head as boxes and pixels (the proposal).
commands.chainsawhead.mesh: The head as it is now.
contract.chainsawman.drop.title: Your hands are full. Which contract do you give up?
commands.chainsaw.contract.hybrid: %s is a hybrid (Pochita's heart) and cannot hold a contract.
chainsawman.forever.human_only: Eternity works in human form only.
chainsawman.forever.no_target: Eternity has nothing to hold: look at something living.
chainsawman.forever.hungry: There is nothing left of you for Eternity to eat.
subtitles.chainsawman.hotel.heartbeat: A heart beats in the wall
subtitles.chainsawman.devil.grow: The devil grows out of the walls
message.chainsawman.devil.noheart: My heart is not here. You cannot kill me.
message.chainsawman.squad.fed: %s eats like a starving man. He gets up.
message.chainsawman.squad.calm: %s stops. He is shaking. He follows you.
message.chainsawman.squad.thanks: The squad is out. Public Safety will remember it (%s saved).
message.chainsawman.hotel.loot: The devil's flesh and blood are in your pack.
message.chainsawman.hotel.sealed: The doors close behind you. Nobody comes in. Nobody leaves.
message.chainsawman.devil.held: Someone else holds my name. I have nothing left to give you.
message.chainsawman.devil.beg: Let me live. I'll give you forever.
message.chainsawman.devil.hybrid: There is already a devil in you. I will not share.
message.chainsawman.devil.sink: Take it. Take it all. Let me go down.
message.chainsawman.devil.broken: Then end it. I cannot fight any more.
contract.chainsawman.screen.title: CONTRACT
contract.chainsawman.screen.power: FOREVER: lock one in an endless moment
contract.chainsawman.screen.lasting: You can never sleep through the night again
contract.chainsawman.screen.use.label: EACH TIME YOU USE IT
contract.chainsawman.screen.use: Time catches up with you: it eats your hunger
contract.chainsawman.screen.hybrid: Your heart leaves no room for another devil
message.chainsawman.too_weak: Too hurt to give them your blood
message.chainsawman.fallen.you: You are down. A friend can pick you up. Hold %s to give up.
message.chainsawman.buddy.have: You already have a buddy. /chainsaw buddy end to end it.
message.chainsawman.buddy.asked: You asked %s to be your buddy.
message.chainsawman.buddy.asks: %s asks you to be their buddy. Crouch and right-click them with an empty hand to say yes.
message.chainsawman.buddy.now: You and %s are buddies now. Near each other you take less damage and pick each other up faster.
message.chainsawman.buddy.ended_by: %s ended it. You have no buddy now.
message.chainsawman.buddy.ended_away: Your buddy ended it while you were away.
commands.chainsaw.buddy.none: You have no buddy. Crouch and right-click a player with an empty hand to ask.
message.chainsawman.giveup.none: You do not carry a heart.
message.chainsawman.giveup.ask: Give up the heart? You will be human again, and Pochita's heart goes back into the world, far from here. This cannot be undone.
message.chainsawman.giveup.confirm: [Click here, or run /chainsaw giveup confirm, to give it up]
message.chainsawman.giveup.done: The heart leaves you. You are human again. Somewhere far away, Pochita is waiting for someone else.
message.chainsawman.giveup.away: While you were away, the heart left you. You are human again, and Pochita waits somewhere else now.
message.chainsawman.theft.you: Someone is tearing out your heart! Mash %s!
message.chainsawman.theft.hit: You were hit. The heart slips from your hand.
message.chainsawman.theft.settling: The heart has only just changed hands. It will not come loose for a day.
message.chainsawman.theft.lost: %s tore your heart out. You are human.
message.chainsawman.theft.took: You tore out the heart. It beats in your chest now.
commands.chainsaw.bond: %s's bond with Eternity is step %s (%s uses).
chainsawman.bond.eternity.3: Not yet. Nothing has to end.
chainsawman.heart.level.2: The heart drinks. It wants more.
chainsawman.heart.level.3: The heart is hungry no more. It is the devil now.
message.chainsawman.theft.contracts: A heart fills every slot: the contracts you held are over.
message.chainsawman.tomato_seeds: Its seeds are in the ground. Burn them or cut them up.
